lines.zh: 我齿轮嗡嗡响，一路飞过去。
lines.en: My gears hum as I fly along.
I fly low over the crystal thicket, steady.

lines.zh: 我一边飞一边找可开采的矿。
lines.en: I search for mineable ore as I fly.
My wings are two thin plates of iron.

lines.zh: 齿轮转着，我贴着地面飞。
lines.en: Gears turning, I skim the ground.
I head for that patch of originium.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方有细碎的响。
lines.en: A faint ticking follows my flight.

lines.zh: 我忽高忽低，找合适的角度。
lines.en: I rise and dip, looking for the right angle.
I drift over the ore vein.

lines.zh: 我一路抖着，齿轮卡了一下。
lines.en: I judder along, a gear catching.

lines.zh: 我沿着地面低飞，避开枝桠。
lines.en: I skim low, dodging branches.
I head toward the steady rhythm.

lines.zh: 我飞得很轻，像一片铁屑。
lines.en: I fly lightly, like a fleck of iron.
I fly low along the ore vein.
I circle twice over your head.
I come near you, then pull away.

lines.zh: 我停在空中，翅膀还在颤。
lines.en: I hover, wings still quivering.

lines.zh: 我落在一块源石上，歇一会。
lines.en: I settle on a lump of originium and rest.
My gears turn slowly and softly.
I am listening to the sound inside the ore.
I turn my head to look at you.
I shake the dust off myself.

lines.zh: 我的复眼一格一格地亮。
lines.en: My compound eyes brighten cell by cell.
I hang there like a nail.
I fold my wings slowly.
I tuck my legs beneath me.

lines.zh: 我身上有一处螺钉松了。
lines.en: One of my screws has come loose.
I wait for the originium to grow a little.
You smell of rust, and I like it.
Are you going to feed me? I am waiting.
My gear wings buzz and whir.
My eyes are fixed on your hands.
Do not take that ore.
I circle your head, very close.
Hold out your hand and I will come down.
My wings buzz at your ear.
You stand firmly; I am not afraid.
This, I can guide you to.
How much do you know about originium?
I tilt, as if nodding.
The iron on you is very new.

lines.zh: 我落到你肩上，试着站稳。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and try to steady.
A swat spins me over.
My wing bends and I fly unsteadily.
I lose a screw.
Buzzing, I retreat upward.
A gear catches.
I cannot stop and hit the stone.
I shudder before flying again.
A screw falls out of my casing.
A patch of my compound eye dims.
I pull back and circle you.
Smell of iron! Give me a little.
That scrap of iron will do for my teeth.
Raise the iron and I will come.
I want to grind my teeth on something.
That scrap iron will last me a long while.
Half a block lower, and the iron is mine.

lines.zh: 我朝你手上的东西贴过去。
lines.en: I press toward what is in your hand.
Your pickaxe is iron.
Where there is iron, I go.
My wings quiver, and I am eager.
You bump me and I fly off crooked.
I hit your shoulder, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 我的齿轮卡了一下，声音很响。
lines.en: A gear jams with a loud click.

lines.zh: 你抬手的风把我推偏了。
lines.en: The wind from your hand pushes me aside.

lines.zh: 我被撞得掉了一颗螺钉。
lines.en: The knock shakes a screw loose.

lines.zh: 我贴在你身上，翅膀还在转。
lines.en: I cling to you, wings still turning.
My wings catch, and I drop two turns.
I circle back and bump again.

lines.zh: 你把我扫开，我又飞回来。
lines.en: You sweep me away and I fly back.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我身上亮了一下。
lines.en: At the impact, something on me flickers.

lines.zh: 我是机械做的，繁殖不了。
lines.en: I am made of machinery; I cannot breed.

lines.zh: 我的程序里没有这一条。
lines.en: That line is not in my routine.

lines.zh: 两只蜂撞在一起就够了。
lines.en: Two bees bumping is enough.
Only iron interests me.
I tilt my head, uncomprehending.
Gears and gears do not make little bees.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，飞开一点。
lines.en: I flick my wings and drift off a bit.
That is for the oriworms to do.
I go back to grinding my teeth.
I buzz twice as an answer.

lines.zh: 我夹起一小块铁，往上飞。
lines.en: I pinch a scrap of iron and fly up.
I hug it with my legs and carry it off.
I will keep this bit of ore for my teeth.
I cannot lift the bigger ones.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里藏了一块铁
lines.en: I hide a piece of iron in the rock seam.
The iron is heavy, and I fly crooked.
I carry this iron back to my nest.
This iron has a good color; I will take it.
My wings are made of gears.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把它拖到矿脉边。
lines.en: I drag it slowly over to the vein.
I have my eye on the iron in your hand.

lines.zh: 我的齿轮翅一转，就是嗡嗡声。
lines.en: My gear-wings turn with a buzz.
I am flying over to you.
I want to keep an eye on this ore.

lines.zh: 你手上有铁锈味，我跟你
lines.en: Your hands smell of rust; I follow you.
I lock onto your wrist.
There is a vein where you stand.
I circle you, looking for an angle.
I go toward the movement in your hand.
There is iron in this direction.
I keep circling you.
I follow the sound of your iron gear.
I rest on your shoulder a moment.

lines.zh: 我的嗡嗡声一直在你耳边。
lines.en: My buzzing stays at your ear.
You reach into your pocket and I come close.
I follow you along the vein.

lines.zh: 你停下，我就在上方悬着。
lines.en: You stop and I hover overhead.

lines.zh: 齿轮翅一响，我从边上过。
lines.en: My gear-wings click as I pass at the edge.

lines.zh: 你的铁件在响，我听得见。
lines.en: Your ironwork rings, and I can hear it.
The clatter of my gears draws nearer.
I dive and strike your hand.
My teeth grind across your knuckle.
That blow came with a buzz.
I clamp your finger with my legs.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后又撞一下。
lines.en: I circle behind you and strike again.
My wing sweeps across your face.

lines.zh: 这一下把铁屑都带起来了。
lines.en: That blow kicked up iron dust.
You shake your hand and I fly off.
I strike and retreat upward.
That was only for the iron.

lines.zh: 我先是一声嗡嗡，然后才现身。
lines.en: First a buzz, then I appear.

lines.zh: 我从矿脉的缝里飞出来。
lines.en: I fly out of a crack in the vein.

lines.zh: 我落在你面前的石头上。
lines.en: I land on the stone before you.

lines.zh: 一片晶体后面亮了起来。
lines.en: Something lights up behind a crystal.

lines.zh: 我抖着翅膀，从丛里飞起。
lines.en: I rise from the thicket, wings quivering.
I buzz once by your ear.
I circle that patch of originium.
I lift off from beside your tools.
I pause on your hat to rest.
I fly nearer, a little at a time.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的外壳就发软。
lines.en: Fire softens my shell.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔得壳响。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my shell clatters.

lines.zh: 水进了我的关节，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Water gets into my joints and I cannot fly.
The blast carries me far away.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的翅膀，破了个口。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing and tears it.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的齿轮全乱了。
lines.en: A spell hits and all my gears jam.

lines.zh: 没有铁吃，我的齿磨不动了。
lines.en: No iron to eat, and my teeth will not turn.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，我的翅膀白转。
lines.en: The void pulls and my wings spin at nothing.
